note: Muon-antineutrino CC-inclusive cross sections at NOvA (NuMI, antineutrino mode). This release ingests the two single-differential projections dsigma/dEnu and dsigma/dQ^2 (per nucleon); the paper's primary triple-differential d3sigma/dTmu dcos(theta_mu) dEavail (48 slices) is not ingested here pending 2D/3D support. Per-bin total uncertainty; no covariance published.
